Sphere

Sphere is a quadric surface, of constant positive Gaussian curvature, defined by an implicit equation, genus 0, embedded, with a continuous symmetry group.

Open Sphere in the interactive viewer →

aperiodic closed closed-orientable def-implicit embedded implemented k-const-positive quadric tradition-classical

About

The set of points at a fixed distance from a centre: the surface of constant positive curvature, the shape that encloses the most volume for its area, and the one every other closed surface is measured against.
